text:
Ori Nakamura: Hi all  Ori here, first day on Eng Runtime (remote, JST). Quick questions: who should I DM for VPN/SSH and MDM enrollment? Can I use my personal Linux laptop (Arch) or do I need a company device? Also curious if anyone wants to swap vinyl recommendations  fun fact: I do weekend pottery classes and once made a mug that survived the dishwasher :)

Maya (People Ops): Welcome Ori!! :tada: Buddy assigned: Kai. Swag + shipping: https://redwood.company/swag-form. BYOD is allowed but requires MDM + full-disk encryption; if you prefer a company laptop we can ship one. Any dietary restrictions?

Kai (Eng): hey Ori  welcome! For SSH/VPN open the IT portal (https://it.redwood/portal) and paste your public key. If you're on Arch, we have a short BYOD checklist (kernel modules, secureboot note)  DM me and I'll share it. For dev environment we have a devcontainer in `git@github.com:redwood/dev-environments` and a minimal local profile if you like to keep configs light.

IT-Bot: IT ticket #IT-12011 opened: "Onboard Ori Nakamura - VPN/SSH/MDM/BYOD"  ETA: 1 business day.

DevEx-Bot: Onboarding checklist ONB-7019 created for Ori Nakamura. Items: MDM enrollment, SSH key, Slack groups, repo ACLs, devcontainer access.

Sam Wells: Sending a quick DM to coordinate repo access and a 20-min pairing session. If you want help adding your public key paste `cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub` here or DM me the string.

Rae (Design): Vinyl swap? yes please  big fan of reissues of 70s jazz. Also welcome excited to see your pottery mug in the virtual show-and-tell :)

Ori Nakamura: Thanks everyone! No dietary restrictions. I'll open the portal ticket and DM Kai my key. Vinyl rec: check out "Meeting of the Spirits" by the Art Ensemble of Chicago if you like adventurous jazz. Looking forward to the pairing session and meeting the team in SF when I visit!
